_note: The Pale Deep, level 16: a realm under the sea. See docs/zones.md.

pale_deep.name: the Pale Deep
pale_deep.description: A realm under the sea, lit by things that glow.

exposure.name: breath
exposure.warn: Your lungs are burning. Get to an air bell.
exposure.relief: You gasp in the bell's air.

exposure.name: breath
exposure.warn: Your lungs are burning. Get to an air bell.
exposure.relief: You gasp in the bell's air.

pd_landing.name: The Whirl's End
pd_landing.description: Where the whirlpool lets out: a bubble of air on the sea floor, and pale light everywhere.

pd_bell.name: The Great Air Bell
pd_bell.description: A huge bronze bell on the sea floor, full of air. The merrow court sits inside it.

pd_kelp.name: The Kelp Abyss
pd_kelp.description: Kelp forests going down into the black. A small air-bell hangs empty on a chain.

features.buoy: An empty air-bell on a chain. It could be filled.

pd_angler.name: The Angler's Lair
pd_angler.description: A lair at the bottom of the abyss, lit by a single dangling lure.

pd_trench.name: The Trench Edge
pd_trench.description: The edge of a trench so deep it has no bottom.

pd_reach.name: The Leviathan's Reach
pd_reach.description: The trench wall, and something moving along it, longer than a street.

pd_wreck.name: The Sunken Galleon
pd_wreck.description: A galleon on a ledge, its hold full of air casks.

features.cask: An air cask, still sealed. It could fill a bell.

drowned_pearl.name: Drowned Pearl
drowned_pearl.description: A black pearl the size of a fist. One of three relics.

ysse.name: Queen Ysse
ysse.label: Merrow Queen
ysse.description: a merrow with a crown of coral and a tail like a sword
ysse.details: A merrow with a crown of coral and a tail like a sword.

topics.work: Ask me about the deep (for a helm), the bells, or the pearl.

deep.text: You'll drown out there without a helm. Ask me for the helm.

bells.text: Our air bells are failing. Fill the buoy-bell in the Kelp Abyss, and bring air from the galleon's casks. Take these bellows.

pearl.text: The Angler Queen swallowed the Drowned Pearl. Kill her and it's yours: it opens something, in your world.

lure.sense: {Where}, the deep note of a great bell under water.
lure.rumour: The Merrow Queen asks favours of air-breathers.

glass_eel_1.name: Glass Eel
glass_eel_1.label: Eel
glass_eel_1.description: a see-through eel with a glowing spine
glass_eel_1.details: A see-through eel with a glowing spine.

leviathan.name: the Leviathan
leviathan.label: Leviathan
leviathan.description: something longer than a street, sliding past
leviathan.details: Something longer than a street, sliding past.

angler_queen.name: the Angler Queen
angler_queen.label: Angler
angler_queen.description: a fish as big as a house, all teeth below a lure
angler_queen.details: A fish as big as a house, all teeth below a lure.

attacks.name: lure
attacks.hit: {actor}'s lure flares, and she snaps at {target}!

tideglass_trident.name: Tideglass Trident
tideglass_trident.description: A trident of tideglass. In cold wet weather it's unstoppable.

diving_helm.name: Diving Helm
diving_helm.description: A merrow helm of glass and sealskin, full of air. Keeps you breathing.

deep-whirlpool.name: the whirlpool
deep-whirlpool.depart: You swim up into the spiral, and it spits you out into the rain.
deep-whirlpool.arrive: {actor} bursts up out of the whirlpool.

helm.goal: Ask Ysse for a helm: DISCUSS HELM WITH YSSE.

effects.text: "WEAR HELM. Four breaths without it, and you're ours."

bellows.goal: Take the bellows: DISCUSS BELLOWS WITH YSSE.

cask.goal: Draw air from the galleon's casks, past the Leviathan: USE BELLOWS ON CASK.

effects.text: The bellows swell with old air.

buoy.goal: Fill the buoy-bell in the Kelp Abyss: USE BELLOWS ON BUOY.

effects.text: The bell fills, and lifts on its chain.

back.goal: Tell Ysse: DISCUSS BELLS WITH YSSE.

kill.goal: Kill the Angler Queen, at the bottom of the Kelp Abyss.

back.goal: Show Ysse: DISCUSS PEARL WITH YSSE.

effects.text: "Keep it. There's a door in a drowned city of yours. It will know what to do."
